children: The European Central Bank's Isabel Schnabel could leave the central bank earlier than planned for a job with the International Monetary Fund (IMF), the Handelsblatt newspaper reported on Thursday, citing government and finance sources.

If Schnabel, whose term as executive board member runs until the end of 2027, were to leave, Bundesbank President Joachim Nagel would be the only German candidate left in the running to succeed Christine Lagarde, added the newspaper.
